11:6: Ur illi lweḥc di tmurt, mebla ma illa ṛṛeẓq is ar Ṛebbi. Issen tanezduɣt is, tanṭelt is. Meṛṛa, di Tezmamt iţbegginen.
11:7: D Neţţa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Asgeld iS illa ɣef waman. A kwen Ijeṛṛeb anwi segwen ara ixedmen ayen ilhan, sennig wiyaḍ. Ma tenniḍ: "ih, kunwi a d tekkrem deffir tmeţţant nnwen", wid ijehlen, war ccekk, a d inin: "ayagi, kan, d ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ".
11:8: Ma Neswexxeṛ asen aɛaqeb ar imir iţwassnen, war ccekk, a d inin: "d acu iT iṭṭfen"? Ass ideg ara ten id iaweḍ, day illa wa ara ten iḍeṛṛfen segs? Ad asen izzi wayen iɣef ţmmaɛliken.
11:9: Ma Nesḥess i umdan aḥunu nneɣ, sinna, Nekkes as t, atan ad iayes, ad ijhel.
11:10: Ma Nesḥess as lɣit, deffir twaɣit i t innulen, atan ad yini: "fukkent felli lemḥayen", dɣa, neţţa, ad ifṛeḥ, ad izux.
11:11: Kkes ed wid iṣebbṛen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I widak ssmaḥ akked tikci meqqwṛen.
11:12: Ahat teţţaoaḍ kra n wayen ik ed iţţuweḥḥan. Pzemmiḍen yis idmaren ik mara qqaṛen: "a lemmer i s d irs ugerruj, neɣ idda d, yides, lmelk"! Kečč d aneddaṛ kan. Ṛebbi d Awkil n yal cci.
11:13: Neɣ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed, s usnulfu, mraw n tsuṛtin am neţţa. Naɛṛet ayen iwumi tzemrem, war Ṛebbi, ma tessawalem tideţ".
11:14: Ma ur awen d rran ara, cfut ar irs ed kan s tussna n Ṛebbi, ar ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Ihi, ma kunwi d imḍuɛen?
11:15: I wid ibɣan tameddurt n ddunit akked ṛṛḥuḥ is, a Nkafi, degs, igiten nnsen, ur asen Ntekkes.
11:16: Widak, ur ţţafen, di laxeṛt, siwa times. Ad iɣli wayen ṣenɛen degs; inqeḍ wayen xeddmen.
11:17: Day win iddan d ubeggen, sɣuṛ Mass is, u immal as t unagi sɣuṛeS…? U, uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aḥunu. Wigi umnen yis. Win i ţ inekṛen, seg ikubar, ţţaɛud is d times. Ur ţţili di ccekk fellas. Neţţa, ih, d tideţ sɣuṛ Mass ik. Maca, tegwti n medden ur ţţamnen.
11:18: Anwa idensen sennig win id isnulfan tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi? Wigi a d rsen i Mass nnsen. A d inin inagan: "d wigi i iskaddben ɣef Mass nnsen". Day Ṛebbi ur Ixezzu yara imednas?
11:19: I isṭixxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, i t issarmen d uɛwij, nitni ur uminen s laxeṛt?
11:20: Wigi, ur sfunnugen di tmurt, ur asen illi bab, war Ṛebbi. Fellasen aɛaqeb ar wayeḍ. Ur zmiren ad slen, ur ţwalin.
11:21: D wigi i isxesṛen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
11:22: Ur illi ccekk, ih, nitni ad xesṛen, di laxeṛt, sennig wiyaḍ.
11:23: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u unzen aS i Mass nnsen, widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkṛen.
11:24: Amedya n snat n trebbuyaɛ am uderɣal, uɛẓẓug, akked win iţwalin, win isellen. Day ɛadlen sin imedyaten agi? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
11:25: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ i ugdud is: "nek d aneddaṛ nnwen iţbegginen,
11:26: iwakken ur tɛabdem siwa Ṛebbi. Nek ugaded aɛaqeb fellawen, ass aqeṛhan".
11:27: Nnan imḍebbṛen, wid ijehlen, seg ugdud is: "kečč, ɣuṛneɣ, d amdan am nekwni. Nwala, d ṛṛdiyen nneɣ, kan, war ameyyez, i k iḍefṛen. Ur nwala s wacu i ɣ tifem. Xaṭi, nḥesb ikwen d ikeddaben".
11:28: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddiɣ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aḥunu sɣuṛeS. Idreg fellawen. Day a t nḥeţţem fellawen, ma kunwi tugim t?
11:29: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssutureɣ ayla, ilmend is; taqdiɛt iw ar Ṛebbi kan. Ur ţţaraɣ, nek, wid iumnen. S tideţ, ad mlilen d Mass nnsen. Maca, nek walaɣ kwen d agdud ur nessin.
11:30: A yagdud iw! Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Ṛebbi, lemmer i ten rriɣ akin, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
11:31: Ur awen qqaṛeɣ: ɣuṛi lexzayen n Ṛebbi. Ur ssineɣ tabaḍnit. Ur qqaṛeɣ: nek d lmelk. Ur qqaṛeɣ i wid ḥeqṛent wallen nnwen: ur asen Iţţak ara Ṛebbi lxiṛ, d awezɣi. Yif akw Ṛebbi akken Iẓṛa, i illan deg iman nnsen. Mulac ad iliɣ seg imednas".
11:32: Nnan: "a Nuḥ! Niɣ tnamreḍ aɣ, tessugteḍ aɣ anamer. Ihi, awi yaɣ d ayen i ɣ tɛahdeḍ, ma tessawaleḍ tideţ".
11:33: Inna: "d Ṛebbi kan ar awen t id Iawin, ma ihwa yaS. Kunwi ur tesfunnugem.
11:34: Xas bɣiɣ a kwen neṣḥeɣ, ur tesfaydayam seg wanṣaḥ iw, ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi a kwen Itlef. Neţţa d Mass nnwen; tuɣalin nnwen ɣuṛeS".
11:35: Neɣ qqaṛen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "ma snulfaɣ t id, lbeɣwḍ iw i yiri w. Nek, ur ţţkaɣ di lbeɣwḍ nnwen".
11:36: Iţţuweḥḥa d i Nuḥ: "ur iţţamen yiwen, d awezɣi, seg ugdud ik, siwa wid illan umnen. Ihi, ur k icqi wayen xeddmen.
11:37: Eṣnaɛ lbabuṛ, ger wallen nneɣ, s uweḥḥi nneɣ. Ur iyI d ţmeslay ɣef wid idensen, war ccekk, ad ɣemqen".
11:38: La iṣennaɛ lbabuṛ. Yal tikelt ara ɛaddin ɣuṛes imḍebbṛen n ugdud is, tkaɛriren fellas. Inna: "ma temmaɛlkem degneɣ, ihi, a nemmaɛlek degwen akken temmaɛlkem.
11:39: Deqqal a ţţeẓṛem, uɣuṛ ara d ias uɛaqeb ara t isdullen, ara iḥaz uɛaqeb imezgi".
11:40: Alamma, mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, la ţfeggiḍen igwefran d ihedman, Nenna: "awi degs tayuga n yal ṣṣenf, tawacult ik - siwa wid iɣef id izwar wawal -, akked wid iumnen". Drus kan i iumnen yides.
11:41: Inna: "rekbet degs, s yisem n Ṛebbi, acali s akked trusi s. Mass iw, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
11:42: Icula yissen, di lemwao anect idurar. Issawel Nuḥ i mmi s, i illan weḥdes: "a mmi ali d yidneɣ, ur teţţiliḍ ar ijehliyen"!
11:43: Inna: "ṣṣṛan iw d adrar, ad iyi isellek seg waman". Inna: "assa, ulac leslak si lameṛ n Ṛebbi, siwa i win iɣef Iḥun". Ɛaddant lemwao garasen. Iṣebḥ ed seg wid iţwaɣemqen.
11:44: Nnan: "a tamurt, seblaɛ aman im, a yigenni eṣṣfu". Aman zzren. Iṣaṛ lameṛ: irs ɣef Loudi. Iffeɣ uberraḥ: akin agdud imednas!
11:45: Inuj Nuḥ ar Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Niɣ mmi n twacult iw. Ih, lemɛahda K d tideţ, Kečč Tifeḍ akw imḥaddan".
11:46: Inna: "a Nuḥ! Neţţa, s tideţ, ur illi n wacult ik. Ih, neţţa ur ixdim ayen ilhan. Ihi, ur iyI d steqsay ɣef wayen ur tessineḍ. Nek a k Ssakwayeɣ, ur teţţiliḍ seg wid ur nessin".
11:47: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ili di lɛawen iw, iwakken ur K id steqsayeɣ ɣef wayen ur ssineɣ. Ma ur iyi Tsemmḥeḍ, ur Tḥuneḍ felli, ad iliɣ seg imexsuṛen".
11:48: Nnan d: "a Nuḥ! Ers ed s tifrat sɣuṛneɣ, akked lbaṛaka, fellak akw ɣef leoyus i illan yidek. Kra n legyus, a ten Nɣit. Sinna, fellasen sɣuṛneɣ, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
11:49: Tagi si teqṣiḍin n tbaḍnit, Nweḥḥa yak tent. Ur tent tessineḍ, kečč, neɣ agdud ik, uqbel wagi. Ihi, eṣbeṛ, taggara, war ccekk, i wid iţḥezziben.
11:50: I Ɛad, gmat sen Hud, inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan.
11:51: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssutureɣ taqdiɛt ɣef waya. Taqdiɛt iw ar Win kan, iyi d Ixelqen. Day ur tefhimem ara?
11:52: A yagdud iw! Ssutret ssmaḥ i Mass nnwen, sinna, steṛoɛet aS. Ad awen d Isseɣli ageffur d ihedman, ad awen irnu tazmert i tezmert nnwen. Ur ţţuɣalet d ibeɣwḍiyen".
11:53: Nnan as: "a Hud! Ur aɣ d tusid s ubeggen, ur neţţaoa, nekwni, iṛebbiten nneɣ, ilmend n wawal ik, ur numin yisek.
11:54: Neqqaṛ kan, d kra iṛebbiten nneɣ, i k iɣeṛqen". Inna: "nek, Anagi w d Ṛebbi, u cehhdet ar ur ţţkaɣ ara deg wayen teţcarakem,
11:55: war Neţţa. Ihi, andit iyi akken ma tellam, sinna ur iyi sganayet.
11:56: Nek, ţţekleɣ af Ṛebbi, Mass iw u Mass nnwen. Ur illi umexluq ur Iṭṭif seg ixef is. Ih, Mass iw deg ubrid uwqim.
11:57: Ma wexxṛen, niɣ ssawḍeɣ awen d ayen iɣef id ţţuceggɛaɣ ɣuṛwen. A d Inṣef, Mass iw, agdud war kunwi. Ur T teṭṭuṛum s wacemma. Mass iw, s tideţ, d Amḥareb n yal cci".
11:58: Mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, Nsellek Hud akked wid iumnen yides, s uḥunu sɣuṛneɣ. Nsellek iten seg uɛaqeb uwɛiṛ.
11:59: Akka Ɛad. Nekṛen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, ɛuṣan imazanen iS. Ddan d lameṛ n yal aqehhaṛ iggernennen.
11:60: A ten iḍfeṛ xezzu di ddunit agi, u deg wass n tnekra. Day, war ccekk, ur jhilen ara Ɛad, ar Mass nnsen? Day mačči: "akin Ɛad, agdud n Hud"?
11:61: I Tamud, gmat sen ṢṢaliḥ, inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Neţţa Ixelq ikwen seg wakal, Izzdeɣ ikwen fellas. Ssutret aS ssmaḥ, sinna, steṛoɛet aS. Mass iw, s tideţ, Iqeṛb ed, Iţţara d awal.
11:62: Nnan as: "a Ṣaliḥ, niɣ telliḍ garaneɣ, uqbel aya, d asirem nneɣ. Day ad aɣ tekkseḍ aɛbad n wayen ɛabden imezwura nneɣ? Nekwni, s tideţ, aql aɣ di ccekk imcebbwel, ɣef wayen uɣuṛ la ɣ tneccdeḍ".
11:63: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddiɣ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aḥunu sɣuṛeS. Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Ṛebbi, ma aɛṣaɣ ɣuṛeS? Iyi ternam, siwa taxessaṛt.
11:64: A yagdud iw! Tagi d talɣwemt n Ṛebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Eooet eţ a ţţeks di tmurt n Ṛebbi. Ur ţ ţjeyyifet, mulac a kwen id isami uɛaqeb iqeṛben".
11:65: Gezmen as iḍaṛen. Inna: "zhut deg ixxamen nnwen, kraḍ wussan. Aţan lemɛahda ur neţwankaṛ".
11:66: Mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, Nsellek Ṣaliḥ akked wid iumnen yides, s uḥunu sɣuṛneɣ, si ddell n wass nni. Ih, Mass ik d Uohid, d Uzmir.
11:67: Asuɣu iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,
11:68: amzun ur rbiḥen degsen. Day, s tideţ, ur jhilen ara Tamud, ar Mass nnsen? Day mačči: "akin Tamud"?
11:69: Niɣ usan d imceggɛen nneɣ ar Ibṛahim, s ubecceṛ. Nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat"! Ur iɛaṭṭel ara ibbwi d aɛjmi icwin.
11:70: Mi iwala ifassen nnsen ur d ẓẓilen ara ɣuṛes, isḥassef iten, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ţţagwad, nekwni neţţuceggaɛ ed ar ugdud n Luṭ".
11:71: Tameṭṭut is tbedd, teḍṣa. Nbecceṛ iţ s Isḥaq, akked Yaɛqub, deffir Isḥaq.
11:72: Tenna: "a lḥif iw, day a d arweɣ, nek d tamɣaṛt, u argaz agi inu, wesser? Ayagi, s tideţ, d lwehma"!
11:73: Nnan: "day twehmeḍ di lameṛ n Ṛebbi? Aḥunu n Ṛebbi, akked lbaṛaka S, fellawen ay at uxxam. Ih, Neţţa d Amaɛzuz, Mucaɛ".
11:74: Mi s tekkes tugwdi i Ibṛahim, u iusa t id ubecceṛ, inumer aɣ ɣef ugdud n Luṭ.
11:76: "A Ibṛahim, ur keččem deg waya. Niɣ iusa d lameṛ n Mass ik. Nitni, a ten id ias uɛaqeb, war tifrat".
11:77: Mi usan imceggɛen nneɣ ar Luṭ, innuɣben, ur isɛi iɣil a ten ifukk. Inna: "wagi d ass uwɛiṛ".
11:78: Iusa d ugdud is, zeḥfen d ɣuṛes. Llan, zik, xeddmen tucmitin. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Atent an issi, nitenti zeddigit, i kunwi. Ḥezbet i Ṛebbi, ur iyi ţḥeccimet ar inebgawen iw. Day ur illi ara, garawen, urgaz aḥesbi"?
11:79: Nnan: "niɣ teẓṛiḍ ur nesɛi lḥeqq deg issi k. Kečč, s tideţ, teẓṛiḍ d acu nebɣa".
11:80: Inna: "a lemmer i wen zmireɣ, neɣ sɛiɣ tayeţ ioehden"!
11:81: Nnan: "a Luṭ, nekwni d imceggɛen n Mass ik. Ur k id ţţawḍen. Ṛuḥ akked twacult ik, deg iḍ. Yiwen degwen ur d itezzi! Kkes ed tameṭṭut ik. Neţţat, s tideţ, a ţţeţwwet s wayen ara ten iwwten. Ih, ţţaɛud nnsen, taṣebḥit. Niɣ tqeṛb ed tṣebḥit"?
11:82: Mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, Nesredm iţ. Nesseɣli d fellas abruri n yiẓṛa ibelbaḍen n talaxt.
11:83: Pwanesxen ar Mass ik. Nitni, ur bɛiden i imednas.
11:84: I Madian, gmat sen Cuɛayeb, inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Ur ssenqaset di lkil akked lmizan. Nek, walaɣ kwen teṛwam, u ugadeɣ fellawen aɛaqeb, ass itezzin.
11:85: A yagdud iw! Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur ṭṭuṛṛut imdanen deg wayla nnsen, ur ţdenniset, tessefsadem di tmurt.
11:86: Yif it i kunwi wayen d iqqimen i Ṛebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam. Ur lliɣ, nek, d amḥareb nnwen".
11:87: Nnan: "a Cuɛayeb, day aɣ umṛen wawalen ik, a neoo ayen ɛabden imezwura nneɣ? Neɣ a nexdem, deg wayla nneɣ, ayen ur aɣ nehwi? Kečč, s tideţ, d uḥlim, d uṣwib".
11:88: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam, ma ddiɣ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Iɣat iyi yis, lɣit imaɛnen. Ur bɣiɣ a kwen mgirrdeɣ, siwa ɣef wayen i wen gedleɣ. Bɣiɣ kan, s wayen zemreɣ, ad awen ṣegmeɣ tikli. Lɛawen iw sɣuṛ Ṛebbi kan. Pţekleɣ fellaS, utubeɣ T.
11:89: A yagdud iw! Awer kwen teţţara nnmara w d ibeɣwḍiyen, a ţţeḍṛu yidwen akken teḍṛa d ugdud n Nuḥ, neɣ win n Hud, neɣ win n Ṣaliḥ! Agdud n Luṭ, ur ibɛad ara segwen.
11:90: Ssutret ssmaḥ i Mass nnwen, sinna, steroɛet aS. Mass iw, s tideţ, Iţḥunu, Iţḥemmil".
11:91: Nnan: "a Cuɛayeb, ur nefhim ara aṭas n wayen id tenniḍ. Aql aɣ nwala k d uṛhif garaneɣ. Lemmer mačči d alag ik, war ccekk, a k neṛoem. Ur aɣ tezmireḍ".
11:92: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day Ṛebbi, ɣuṛwen, yif iT walag iw, di tezmert? Terram T ar deffir n waɛrur nnwen. Mass iw, s tideţ, Izzi i wayen txeddmem.
11:93: A yagdud iw! Xedmet deg umekkan nnwen, nek ad xedmeɣ. Deqqal a ţţeẓṛem, uɣuṛ ara d ias uɛaqeb ara t isdullen, anwa ay d akeddab. Ɛasset, nek, yidwen, ad ɛasseɣ".
11:94: Mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, Nsellek Cuɛayeb akked wid iumnen yides, s uḥunu sɣuṛneɣ. Asuɣu iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,
11:95: amzun ur rbiḥen degsen. Day mačči: "akin Madian"! Am: "akin Tamud"?
11:96: Niɣ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nneɣ, akked udabu n ṣṣeḥ,
11:97: ɣuṛ Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Ddan d lameṛ n Ferɛun. Lameṛ n Ferɛun ur illi d uṣwib.
11:98: Ad izwir i ugdud is, ass n tnekra, a ten inheṛ ar usario n tmes. A yasario ucmit uɣuṛ ţwanehṛen!
11:99: A ten iḍfeṛ xezzu di tagi, u deg wass n tnekra. A tikci tucmiţ iţţunefken!
11:100: Ayagi, si teqṣiḍin n temdinin, i k d Nessawal. Garasent tid ibedden, tid iţwamegren.
11:101: Ur ten Nednis. Maca, densen iman nnsen. Ur ten nefɛan s wacemma, iṛebbiten nnsen i la naɛṛen, war Ṛebbi, mi d iusa lameṛ n Mass ik. I sen rnan, siwa ssxeḍ.
11:102: Akka tiyta n Mass ik. Mi Iwwet timdinin i idensen, s tideţ, tiyta S teqṛeḥ, teqseḥ.
11:103: Ih, deg waya, assekni i wid iugaden aɛaqeb n laxeṛt. Ass nni, d ass unejmaɛ n yimdanen. Ass nni, d ass n ccada.
11:104: A t Neswexxeṛ kan ar lajel iuran.
11:105: Ass ideg ara d ias, ur d iţmeslay yiwen, siwa ma s tesriḥ iS. Ad ilin igeswaḥen, isaɛdiyen.
11:106: Wanag igeswaḥen ad ilin di tmes, s unazaɛ d imeṭṭi,
11:107: ad wekkṛen dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. Ih, Mass ik Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
11:108: Wanag isaɛdiyen, di Loennet, ad wekkṛen, dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. D tikci n war tilas.
11:109: Ur k ikeččem ccekk ɣef wayen ɛabden widak. Ayen ɛabden am wayen ɛabden imezwura nnsen, zik. War ccekk, ad asen Nefk amur nnsen, ur inqis.
11:110: Niɣ, s tideţ, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal sɣuṛ Mass ik, yili useyyi garasen. Haaten, ih, di ccekk imcebbwel fellas.
11:111: War ccekk, akken ma llan, ad Ikafi Mass ik igiten nnsen, s lmizan. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issen ayen xeddmen.
11:112: Ihi, ili d uwqim, akken i k iţţunefk lameṛ, kečč akked wid isteṛoɛen yidek. Ur beɣwḍet. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţwali ay txeddmem.
11:113: Ur ţqeṛṛibet ar wid idensen, a kwen tnal tmes! Ur tesɛim bab, war Ṛebbi, ihi, ur teţwasellkem.
11:114: Ẓẓal ṣbeḥ, tameddit, kra n lewqat n yiḍ. S tideţ, iseɣiyen neqqḍen tucmitin. Ayagi d asmekti i wid ismektayen.
11:115: Eṣbeṛ! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḍeggiɛ taqdiɛt n lɛuṣam.
11:116: A lemmer llan, di tsuta i kwen id izwaren, imezgiyen ineqqḍen asefsed di tmurt! Qlilit kan seg wid Nsellek segsen. Wid idensen ddan akked wayen i ten izhan, uɣalen d ibeɣwḍiyen.
11:117: Ur Isquccu ara Mass ik timdinin, d aḥerfi, ma llan imezdaɣ nnsent d lɛuṣam.
11:118: Lemmer i S ihwi i Mass ik, ad Irr imdanen d yiwen n lois. Zgan mgarraden.
11:119: Kkes ed wid iɣef Iḥun Mass ik. Ixelq iten i wayagi. Itam wawal n Mass ik: "ad Acaṛeɣ Loahennama, war ccekk, s leonun akked yimdanen mejmulen".
11:120: Ayen akw i k ed Neḥka n tmucuha imazanen, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yissent. Id iusan dagi d tideţ, d anabi u d asmekti i lmumnin.
11:121: Ini i wid ur numin ara: "xedmet ay tzemrem, nekwni s tideţ, la nxeddem.
11:123: N Ṛebbi tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. ɣuṛeS ara uɣalen akw lumuṛ. Ihi, ɛabed iT, ţţkel fellaS. Ur Iɣeffel ara Mass ik, ɣef wayen txeddmem.
12:1: Alṛ. Wigi d issekniyen n Tazmamt iţbegginen.
12:2: Ih, Nessader it id d Leqwṛan, s taɛṛabt, amar a ţfehmem.
12:3: Nekwni Nḥekku yak tiḥkayin igerzen maḍi, deg wayen i k Nweḥḥa di Leqwṛan agi, xas telliḍ, uqbel is, seg wid istehzan.
12:4: Mi inna Yusef i baba s: "a baba! Nek walaɣ mrawyan itran, iṭij, akked waggur, walaɣ ten knan iyi".
12:5: Inna: "a mmi! Ur ḥekku ayen twalaḍ i watmaten ik, ad ak andin ticeṛkeţ. Cciṭan, s tideţ, d acengu n ṣṣeḥ n umdan.
12:6: Akka, a k Ifren Mass ik, u ak Isselmed asefru n temsal, u ad Itim lɣit iS, i kečč akked twacult n Yaɛqub, akken it Itam, zik, af lejdud ik: Ibṛahim akked Isḥaq. Mass ik, s tideţ, d Amusnaw, d Uṣwib".
12:7: Niɣ, di Yusef akked watma s, illa ussekni i wid isteqsayen.
12:8: Mi nnan: "war ccekk, ifen aɣ, Yusef akked gma s, akken iten iḥemmel babat nneɣ, u nekwni d ṭṭeṛma. Babat nneɣ, s tideţ, haat di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
12:9: Enɣet Yusef, neɣ nfut eţ si tmurt, a d ilhu degwen babat wen, sinna, a ţţuɣalem d imdanen ixeddmen ayen ilhan".
12:10: Inna win d immeslayen, degsen: "ur neqqet Yusef, ḍeggṛet eţ ar lqaɛa n wannu. Ma tgam akka, a t iddem yiwen umsebrid".
12:11: Nnan: "a babat nneɣ, acu k iuɣen, ur aɣ tumineḍ ara, ɣef Yusef. Nekwni, fellas, s tideţ, d unṣiḥen.
12:12: Sseddu t yidneɣ azekka, ad izhu, ad iurar. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nḥareb fellas".
12:13: Inna: "nek, s tideţ, ɣwebleɣ ma tebbwim t yidwen, ugadeɣ a t ičč lweḥc, kunwi testehzam degs".
12:14: Nnan: "ma ičča t lweḥc, u nekwni d ṭṭeṛma, s tideţ a nili d imexsuṛen".
12:15: Mi t bbwin, mwafaqen a t rṛen ar lqaɛa n wannu, Nweḥḥa yas: "ad asen temleḍ, s tideţ, lameṛ agi nnsen, nitni ur ẓṛin".
12:16: Uɣalen d tameddit, ar babat sen, ţţrun.
12:17: Nnan: "a babat nneɣ, s tideţ, nṛuḥ a nemzizzel, neooa Yusef ar lqecc nneɣ, ičča t lweḥc. Ur aɣ teţţamneḍ, xas nenna d tideţ".
12:18: Bbwin d tasedrit is, degs idamen n rrya. Inna: "xaṭi! D iman nnwen i wen d iccacḍen lameṛ. Ilha ṣṣbeṛ. Anuju ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, mgal ayen d teḥkam".
12:19: Usan d iminigen, uznen win id iţţagwmen, issader ssḍel is. Inna: "a lxiṛ, wagi d aqcic"! Ffren t, amzun d sselɛa. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu xeddmen.
12:20: Zzenzen t, s ṛṛxa, s kra iṣuṛdiyen. Ur as fkin ara azal.
12:21: Inna, i tmeṭṭut is, Umaṣṛi i t iuɣen: "eṛḥeb yis, amar ad aɣ infaɛ, at nerr d mmit nneɣ". Akka ay Nesseqɛad Yusef di tmurt, iwakken ad as Nesseḥfeḍ asefru n temsal. Ṛebbi d Amezwaru s lameṛ iS, maca tegwti n medden ur ẓṛin ara.
12:22: Mi d immeḥtel, Nefka yas ṣṣwab, tussna. Akka ay Neţkafi iɛaṛḍiyen.
12:23: Tebɣa t tin uɣur izdeɣ. Terra tibbura, u tenna: "eyya kečč"! Inna: "ad iyi Ineooi Ṛebbi! Niɣ bab iw iṛḥeb yissi. S tideţ, ur rebḥen imednas".
12:24: S tideţ, tebɣa t, u neţţa ibɣa ţ, lemmer ur iwala ara atebbet n Mass is. Akka, iwakken a Nessebɛad fellas tuccḍa, lɛaṛ. Neţţa, s tideţ, seg imdanen nneɣ izedganen.
12:25: Uzzlen ar tebburt, tcerreg as tasedrit is, si zdeffir. Mmugren, argaz is, ar tebburt. Tenna: "acu ay d aqeṭṭi n win iɛabwlen ad iccmet tawacult ik, siwa lḥebs neɣ aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan"?
12:26: Inna: "d neţţat iyi ibɣan". Icuhhed ed yiwen unagi si twacult is: "ma teqqeṛs tsedrit si zdat, tenna d tideţ, u neţţa d akeddab.
12:27: Ma teqqeṛs tsedrit si zdeffir, teskaddeb, u neţţa seg at tideţ".
12:28: Mi iwala teqqeṛs tsedrit si zdeffir, inna: "ayagi, war ccekk, si nncub nnkwent. Ih, nncub nnkwent d timeqwṛaḥanin.
12:29: A Yusef, ţţu ayagi, u kem ssuter ssmaḥ ubekkaḍ im. Kem, s tideţ, teccḍeḍ".
12:30: La qqaṛent tlawin, di temdint: "tameṭṭut umdebbeṛ tḥemmel acrik is. Teshebl iţ tayri. F akken nwala, aţţan, s tideţ, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ".
12:31: Mi tesla s nncub nnsent, tuzen ɣuṛsent, thegga yasent tanalt. I yal yiwet segsent, tefka tafrut. Tenna: "effeɣ ed garasent". Mi t walant, isdehc itent, jerḥent ifassen nnsent, nnant: "ḥaca Ṛebbi, wagi mačči d amdan, wagi siwa d lmelk ukyis".
12:32: Tenna: "d wagi iɣef iyi tlummemt. Ih, bɣiɣ t, neţţa iqqim zeddig. Ma ur ixdim ara ay s umṛeɣ, war ccekk, ad iţwaḥbes, ad iţwaḥqeṛ".
12:33: Inna: "a Mass iw! Smenyafeɣ lḥebs i wayen uɣur iyi d ssawalent. Ma ur Tesbaɛdeḍ ara felli nncub nnsent, ad maleɣ ɣuṛsent, ad iliɣ seg wid ur nessin".
12:34: Ijaweb as d Mass is. Issebɛad fellas nncub nnsent. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
12:35: Sinna, mi ten usan issekniyen, ufan, war ccekk, ilaq a t irr ar lḥebs, kra n tallit.
12:36: Kecmen yides, ar lḥebs, sin ilmeẓiyen. Inna yiwen degsen: "nek walaɣ iman iw, la teẓẓmeɣ ccṛab". Inna d wayeḍ: "nek walaɣ iman iw, la ţţawiɣ aɣṛum ɣef uqeṛṛu w, la teţţen segs ifrax. Ssefru yaɣ ţ id. Ih, nwala k seg iɛaṛḍiyen".
12:37: Inna: "seg wayen iyi ssɣeṛ Mass iw, ad awen ţ id ssefruɣ, uqbel a kwen id iaweḍ lqut i wen ţţakken. Nek ooiɣ ddin n ugdud ur numin s Ṛebbi, u nitni nekṛen laxeṛt.
12:38: Ddiɣ d ddin n lejdud iw: Ibṛahim, Isḥaq akked Yaɛqub. Ur aɣ iţţunefk a nezdukkel acemma i Ṛebbi. Ayagi si lfeḍl n Ṛebbi fellaneɣ, akw ɣef imdanen. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
12:39: A yimeddukwal iw n lḥebs, menyif imawlan imfaṛaqen, neɣ Ṛebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ?
12:40: Ay tɛabdem, war Neţţa, d ismawen kan i sen tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur asen d Issers ara Ṛebbi kra udabu. Lḥukm ar Ṛebbi kan. Iumeṛ ed ur tɛabdem, siwa Neţţa. D wagi ay d ddin uṣwib, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
12:41: A yimeddukwal iw n lḥebs, wanag yiwen degwen ad ismiri ccṛab, i bab is, wayeḍ ad iţţusemmeṛ ɣef umidag, ifrax ad nneqben aqeṛṛu s. Iţţuseyya lameṛ ɣef wayen iyi d testeqsam".
12:42: Inna i win iḥṣa ad islek, segsen: "ar bab ik, smekti iyi d". Cciṭan iseţţu t, ur t id ismekti ar bab is. Irna, di lḥebs, kra iseggwasen.
12:43: Inna ugellid: "nek walaɣ ṣa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teţţent ṣa tuḍɛifin, akked ṣa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyaḍ d tiqquṛanin. A yimḍebbṛen, ssefrut iyi d targit, ma tellam seg wid issefruyen tirga".
12:44: Nnan: "d tirga iwlellsen. Ur nelli d imusnawen i usefru n tirga".
12:45: Win i isellken si sin nni, armi tallit id immekti, inna: "nek, ad awen d awiɣ asefru ines, aznet iyi.
12:46: A Yusef, bab n tideţ, ssefru yaɣ d: ṣa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teţţent ṣa tuḍɛifin, akked ṣa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyaḍ d tiqquṛanin. Amar, ma uɣaleɣ ar imdanen, amar ad ẓṛen".
12:47: Inna: "zerɛat ṣa iseggwasen imyeḍfaṛen. Ayen tzerɛam, eooet eţ di tyedrin is, siwa cwiṭ ara teččem.
12:48: Sinna, deffir sen, a d asen ṣa iwaɛṛen. Ad ččen ayen i sen theggam siwa cwiṭ, seg wayen txeznem.
12:49: Sinna a d ias, deffir waya, useggwas n tallalt i medden, ideg ara ẓden".
12:50: Inna ugellid: "awit eţ id ɣuṛi". Mi t id iusa umersul, inna: "uɣal ar bab ik, u steqsi t acu ay d lɣeṛḍ n tlawin i ijerḥen ifassen nnsent. Mass iw, s tideţ, Issen nncub nnsent".
12:51: Inna: "acu ara d tinimt mi tebɣamt Yusef"? Nnant: "ḥaca Ṛebbi, ur nufi ɣuṛes tuccḍa". Tenna d tmeṭṭut umḍebbeṛ: "tura, a d tban tideţ. D nek i t ibɣan, ma d neţţa, s tideţ, d bab n tideţ".
12:52: "Akka, iwakken ad iẓeṛ ur t xdiɛaɣ ara s tuffra. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu nncub n lxeyyan.
